name: Descriptions
summary: The facts about one thing, as label and value pairs. It is a definition list, so a screen reader announces each label before the value it belongs to.
summaryZh: 关于一件事的一组事实,每条是一个标签加一个值。它本身就是定义列表,所以读屏会先念标签,再念对应的值。

variants.name: Plain
variants.note: The plain form: the pairs sit straight on the page with no frame around them. The base class on its own is already this, so the modifier is only needed to name the state.

variants.name: Bordered
variants.note: Every pair gets a cell, and the whole list gets a frame.

sizes.name: Small
sizes.note: The value takes the caption size.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default size. The base class is already this size, so it needs no modifier.

sizes.name: Large
sizes.note: The label takes the body size and the value takes the title size.

states.name: Centred
states.note: The pairs are centred in their cells.

states.name: Aligned to the end
states.note: The pairs sit at the end of their cells. The end is the reading end, so a right-to-left reader gets the other side.

parts.name: Header
parts.note: The row above the list. It holds the title and the extra, and it adds no space of its own — a list with no title is not pushed down by one.

parts.name: Title
parts.note: What the list is about, on the left of the header.

parts.name: Extra
parts.note: What acts on the list, on the right of the header.

parts.name: Item
parts.note: One pair. It holds the label and the value.

parts.name: Label
parts.note: The name of the field. It is a dt, so it is read before the value.

parts.name: Content
parts.note: The value. It is a dd, so it is read as the definition of the label above it.

props.name: variant
props.description: Whether the list is framed. The base class is already the plain form.
props.descriptionZh: 这份列表要不要加框。基础类本身就是无边框的那一种。

props.name: columns
props.description: How many pairs sit in one row. It is written to the `--um-descriptions-columns` custom property, because a class cannot carry a number.
props.descriptionZh: 一行里放几对。它写进 `--um-descriptions-columns` 这个自定义属性 —— 类带不了数字。

props.name: labelWidth
props.description: The width of the label column, so the values line up under each other. It is written to the `--um-descriptions-label-width` custom property.
props.descriptionZh: 标签列的宽度,值才能上下对齐。它写进 `--um-descriptions-label-width` 这个自定义属性。

props.name: align
props.description: How the pairs line up in their cells. The ends are written logically, so a right-to-left reader gets the other side; the start run is the base class on its own.
props.descriptionZh: 每一对在自己的格子里怎么对齐。两端按阅读方向写,所以从右往左读的读者拿到的是另一头;靠前对齐就是只写基类。

props.name: border
props.description: Whether the list is framed. It falls back to the variant when it is left out.
props.descriptionZh: 这份列表要不要加框。不传就以变体为准。

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the pairs. The medium size is the base class on its own.
props.descriptionZh: 每一对的尺寸。中号就是只写基类。

slots.name: default
slots.description: The pairs, one div per pair, each holding a dt and a dd. The classes go on them, so the caller does not have to write them.
slots.descriptionZh: 各对,一对一个 div,里面放一个 dt 和一个 dd。类会加在它们身上,使用方不用自己写。

slots.name: title
slots.description: What the list is about. It sits at the start of the header above the list.
slots.descriptionZh: 这份列表讲的是什么。它放在列表上方标题栏的开头。

slots.name: extra
slots.description: What acts on the list. It sits at the end of the header above the list.
slots.descriptionZh: 对这份列表的操作。它放在列表上方标题栏的末尾。

slots.name: label
slots.description: The label of the pair the wrapper writes when the caller writes no pair of its own.
slots.descriptionZh: 使用方没有自己写那一对时,包装组件写出的那一对的标签。

slots.name: item
slots.descriptionZh: 一个标签和它对应的值。

a11y.notes: The list is a real dl, and each pair is a div holding a dt and a dd. A screen reader then reads the label and its value as a term and its definition, and lets the reader step from pair to pair — a grid of divs cannot do that. The div wrapper is part of the HTML standard: a dl may hold div groups.
a11y.notesZh: 这份列表是真的 dl,每一对是一个 div,里面放 dt 和 dd。读屏于是会把标签和值当成「术语 + 定义」来念,读者还能按对往下走 —— 一堆 div 做不到这件事。这层 div 包装是 HTML 标准允许的:dl 里可以放 div 分组。

examples.title: Pairs
examples.description: The plain form: the pairs sit on the page with no frame. The label column is a fixed width, so the values line up under each other.
examples.descriptionZh: 无边框的形态:各对直接排在页面上,没有外框。标签列宽度是固定的,所以各个值上下对齐。

examples.title: Bordered
examples.description: The bordered form puts every pair in a cell. The line between two cells is the gap between them, so the cells line up without the stylesheet having to know which one is last.
examples.descriptionZh: 带边框的形态把每一对放进一个格子里。两个格子之间那道线就是它们之间的间隙,所以各格自然对齐,样式表不必知道哪一个是最后一个。

examples.title: Columns
examples.description: Three pairs per row. The column count is a custom property rather than a class, because it is a number and a class cannot carry one.
examples.descriptionZh: 一行三对。栏数是自定义属性而不是类,因为它是个数字,类带不了数字。

notes: Two things a class name cannot carry are carried by custom properties instead: `--um-descriptions-columns`, the number of pairs per row, and `--um-descriptions-label-width`, the width of the label column. Both are measurements, and a class is a name rather than a number.
notesZh: 有两样东西类名带不了,只能交给自定义属性:`--um-descriptions-columns`(一行放几对)和 `--um-descriptions-label-width`(标签列的宽度)。这两个都是尺寸 —— 类是一个名字,不是一个数字。
